ZPOOL-REOPEN(8)              System Manager's Manual            ZPOOL-REOPEN(8)

NAME
       zpool-reopen — reopen vdevs associated with ZFS storage pools

SYNOPSIS
       zpool reopen [-n] [pool]…

DESCRIPTION
       Reopen  all  vdevs  associated with the specified pools, or all pools if
       none specified.

OPTIONS
       -n  Do not restart an in-progress scrub operation.  This is  not  recom‐
           mended  and can result in partially resilvered devices unless a sec‐
           ond scrub is performed.

OpenZFS                           June 2, 2021                  ZPOOL-REOPEN(8)
